title: Dana I not showing TDD
symptom: Using Dana I pump with AndroidAPS Beta3 ver 4 and previously ver3, the TDD (Total Daily Dose) is not totaling the units. It only shows data for days that AAPS has data for, not loading older data from the pump.
cause: The pump history records before the pump was set up in AAPS are ignored. Only data from setting up the pump in AAPS is accepted.
fix: The issue is that only data from setting up the pump in AAPS is accepted; older data is not taken into account. The user was informed that it works as intended after understanding this.
evidence_quote: only data from settin up pump in AAPS is accepted
